sensor.note: telematics clock aligned on its acceleration spike = video impact

contradictions.summary: Traffic constable on duty estimates the bus at ~55 km/h; calibrated CCTV and telematics measure 16 ± 4 km/h.
contradictions.explanation: Suggestion: eyewitness speed estimates for large vehicles approaching head-on are often inflated, especially under stress.

contradictions.summary: Traffic constable on duty says the bus did not slow down; telematics and video record braking before impact.
contradictions.explanation: Suggestion: braking at low speed produces little visible pitch or sound; it is easy to miss from the side.

contradictions.summary: Motorcyclist says a white car cut in front of the bus; the only white car in view is stationary in the right lane before impact.
contradictions.explanation: Suggestion: the witness may be explaining the bus's swerve after the fact, or saw a vehicle outside the camera view.

contradictions.summary: Shopkeeper places the crash around 17:45; the CCTV overlay clock reads 17:31 (14 min apart).
contradictions.explanation: Suggestion: an approximate recollection, or the CCTV clock itself may be off; check the recorder's clock drift.

contradictions.summary: Shopkeeper says the policeman fell on the road; the officer is tracked upright and moving away after impact.
contradictions.explanation: Suggestion: from 11 m across the road, the officer jumping clear can look like a fall.

contradictions.summary: Traffic constable on duty (~55 km/h) and Motorcyclist (~20 km/h) disagree on the bus speed.

gaps.note: Bus not yet in view: its approach before this point is covered only by Witness 1's untimed account.

hypotheses.text: The bus was travelling fast (over 40 km/h)
The bus did not brake before the impact
Another vehicle cut in front of the bus and forced it left
The bus drifted left into the divider at low speed with no other vehicle involved

counterfactual.note: Distance the bus covered from T-1.6 s (officer clearly in its path) to the divider: 4.7 m. Slider: would it have stopped short?
